title: Publish each durable worker's heartbeat line to the run feed (f6o, n0r)
body: y03 gives the per-worker heartbeat (workerview.HeartbeatLine: commits and delta, model calls, the last tool and its age) to ticfac watch <run> <tick>. f6o's own acceptance asks for an activity line in the RUN FEED every 5 minutes or less, so that ticfac watch <run> / events / status look quiet only when a worker truly is. The supervisor (local) or the WorkerAgent (cloud) could fold its own worker's commit stream with internal/workerview (or its TS equivalent) and emit a feed stage on that cadence; optionally also settled events (n0r).
